zone.description: Default workstation zone, replacing FedoraWorkstation (which permits all initiated-return traffic via 1025-65535/tcp open). SSH stays reachable from anywhere because WAN port forwarding to this port is in use; DHCPv6 replies and mDNS (link-local discovery) are also allowed. Every other network service is reachable only through the source-bound workstation-lan zone. Unmatched traffic is rejected, not dropped, so misconfigured LAN peers fail fast instead of timing out.
